name: catalog/chunk_timeout
description: A chunk task request to the worker ran past its deadline and Cloud Run answered 504. Since spec 15 every delivery stops on a time budget well inside the deadline, so any 504 here means the budget is wrong.
filter: resource.type="cloud_run_revision" AND resource.labels.service_name=~"^catalog-" AND resource.labels.service_name="catalog-worker" AND logName="projects/image-links-agent/logs/run.googleapis.com%2Frequests" AND httpRequest.status=504 AND httpRequest.requestUrl:"/tasks/catalog/chunk"
